programme.title: Sam Thompson On His Anxiety And Undiagnosed ADHD
programme.desc: Sam Thompson discusses how anxiety and undiagnosed ADHD have shaped his relationships and self-confidence. He shares his experience of panic attacks, including one on the first day of I'm A Celebrity, and talks about therapy, the patterns he kept repeating, and his three go-to people during crises. Sam and Fearne debate people-pleaser approaches to leaving parties and discuss behind-the-scenes stories from his content creation work. Sam also reveals why he was willing to pay to appear on I'm A Celebrity.

programme.title: Sam Claflin Asks What Is Body Dysmorphia?
programme.desc: Actor Sam Claflin discusses his lifelong struggle with body dysmorphia and body image with Fearne Cotton. Sam explains what having body dysmorphia means to him and how it affects everything from the food he eats to his willingness to watch his own films back. Fearne and Sam discuss being chronic people pleasers and how they're working to stop putting everyone else's comfort before their own. Sam reflects on how he was brought up to think about masculinity and what he's doing to ensure his own son grows up with gentler male role models. They also reminisce about the early days of MSN and webcam chatrooms.

programme.title: Chris Appleton: From Being Bullied to Styling the Kardashians
programme.desc: Celebrity hair stylist Chris Appleton chats with Fearne about why we change our hair when we want to start over. Chris explains that everyone from the Kardashians to cancer patients have opened up to him about their insecurities, and he's seen the profound impact that looking more like yourself on the outside can have on how you feel about yourself on the inside. He's fascinated by the self-limiting beliefs people have about who they are. Chris has dealt with a lot of his own shame and fears too. He was bullied at school, struggled to acknowledge his sexuality, and had huge imposter syndrome when he first arrived in Hollywood. He also gives Fearne a consultation about going bolder with her hair. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicidal ideation.
